verdict.rationale: Phoenix exposes a Python SDK, REST-like client, and MCP endpoint that can query/operate on projects, traces, datasets, experiments, prompts, and annotations—covering most core workflows programmatically, and evaluators/datasets/prompts can all be managed via SDK. However, some UI-specific actions like human annotation labeling are described as UI-attached, and no formal OpenAPI/swagger spec was found (probe returned 404s), suggesting API parity isn't fully documented or guaranteed for every UI feature.
